description_en: Lists the system and custom TTS voices available for large model-based outbound calls
description_zh: 获取大模型外呼支持的TTS音色列表，包括系统预置音色和个性化音色
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs list-available-tts --tts-voice-code V9A000000 --voice-type SYSTEM --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAvailableTts

parameters.help_en: The voice code for a custom voice. You can find it on the Custom Voice (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/voiceprint) page
parameters.help_zh: 个性化音色编码，在个性化音色 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/engine/voiceprint)界面查看音色编码
parameters.name: tts_voice_code

parameters.help_en:
The type of the TTS voice. Valid values:

`SYSTEM`: system voice.

`COSYCLONE`: cloned voice.

`BL-CUSTOM`: premium custom voice
parameters.help_zh:
TTS音色类型枚举值。

`SYSTEM`-系统音色。

`COSYCLONE`-复刻音色。

`BL-CUSTOM`-定制精品复刻音色
